the development of new optical devices based on silicon waveguides and on the development of new methods for their characterization and modeling.
the study of the optical properties of metal nanostructures and the development of new plasmon-enhanced devices.
the design of novel integrated optical devices based on the coupling of light to gap plasmon polaritons.
